text: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
plain: You can act against what you love because you love something bigger. Know which one wins.
People remember your mistakes and forget your good. Build with that in mind.

text:
But yesterday the word of Caesar might
Have stood against the world; now lies he there,
And none so poor to do him reverence.
plain: Yesterday he could face the world. Today nobody bothers to bow. Power is borrowed.

text:
O judgement, thou art fled to brutish beasts,
And men have lost their reason.
plain: A crowd will lose its judgment fast. Keep yours when everyone else loses theirs.
Betrayal from someone you trusted cuts deeper than any blade. That is what finished him.
When someone gets overly polite with you, the warmth is already gone. Real loyalty has no tricks.

text:
There is no terror, Cassius, in your threats,
For I am arm’d so strong in honesty,
That they pass by me as the idle wind,
Which I respect not.
plain: If you are honest with yourself, other people's threats and noise just pass through you.

text:
There is a tide in the affairs of men,
Which, taken at the flood, leads on to fortune;
Omitted, all the voyage of their life
Is bound in shallows and in miseries.
On such a full sea are we now afloat,
And we must take the current when it serves,
Or lose our ventures.
plain: There is a window for every big move. Take it when it opens or spend the rest of your life stuck.

text:
But it sufficeth that the day will end,
And then the end is known.
plain: You will never know how it turns out in advance. It is enough that the day ends and you get through it.

text:
If we do meet again, why, we shall smile;
If not, why then this parting was well made.
plain: Part with someone like it might be the last time, and be at peace either way.

text:
But, since the affairs of men rest still incertain,
Let’s reason with the worst that may befall.
plain: Nothing in life is certain, so think through the worst case first and plan for it.

text:
This was the noblest Roman of them all.
All the conspirators save only he,
Did that they did in envy of great Caesar;
He only, in a general honest thought
And common good to all, made one of them.
His life was gentle, and the elements
So mix’d in him that Nature might stand up
And say to all the world, “This was a man!”
plain: Be the one who acted for the common good while the rest acted from envy. That is how you get remembered.

text: Nothing will come of nothing: speak again.
plain: You cannot get results from zero effort. If you say nothing, nothing shows up.

text:
Fairest Cordelia, that art most rich, being poor;
Most choice forsaken; and most lov’d, despis’d!
plain: The person with nothing to offer but their character can be the richest one in the room.

text: Love cools, friendship falls off, brothers divide: in cities, mutinies; in countries, discord; in palaces, treason; and the bond cracked ’twixt son and father.
plain: When times turn, even the closest bonds crack. Do not be shocked when people fall off.

text:
Have more than thou showest,
Speak less than thou knowest,
Lend less than thou owest,
Ride more than thou goest,
Learn more than thou trowest,
Set less than thou throwest;
plain: Show less than you have, say less than you know, lend less than you owe, and learn more than you believe.

text: Now thou art an O without a figure: I am better than thou art now. I am a fool, thou art nothing.
plain: Once you give away everything that made you someone, you are a zero. Do not hand over your power.

text:
Doth any here know me? This is not Lear;
Doth Lear walk thus? speak thus? Where are his eyes?
Either his notion weakens, his discernings
Are lethargied. Ha! waking? ’Tis not so!
Who is it that can tell me who I am?
plain: The moment you lose your titles and people stop answering to you, you have to ask who you are underneath.

text:
How sharper than a serpent’s tooth it is
To have a thankless child!
plain: Being betrayed by the people you gave everything to hurts worse than any enemy.

text:
How far your eyes may pierce I cannot tell:
Striving to better, oft we mar what’s well.
plain: Trying too hard to improve something can ruin what was already working.

text: Thou shouldst not have been old till thou hadst been wise.
plain: Do not grow old before you grow wise.

text: Fortune, good night: smile once more, turn thy wheel!
plain: Say good night to bad luck and dare it to turn around. Keep going.

text:
O, reason not the need: our basest beggars
Are in the poorest thing superfluous:
Allow not nature more than nature needs,
Man’s life is cheap as beast’s.
plain: Strip a person down to only what they need and they are no better off than an animal. Dignity needs more than survival.

text:
I am a man
More sinn’d against than sinning.
plain: Sometimes you have done less wrong than what has been done to you. It is allowed to feel that.

text: O, that way madness lies; let me shun that;
plain: Some thoughts lead only to madness. Know them and turn away.

text: Thou art the thing itself: unaccommodated man is no more but such a poor, bare, forked animal as thou art.
plain: Take away the clothes, the money, the titles, and a person is just a bare animal. Remember what you actually are.

text:
When we our betters see bearing our woes,
We scarcely think our miseries our foes.
Who alone suffers, suffers most i’ the mind,
Leaving free things and happy shows behind:
But then the mind much sufferance doth o’erskip
When grief hath mates, and bearing fellowship.
plain: Suffering alone is the worst kind. When you see others carrying the same weight, yours gets lighter.

text:
Yet better thus, and known to be contemn’d,
Than still contemn’d and flatter’d. To be worst,
The lowest and most dejected thing of fortune,
Stands still in esperance, lives not in fear:
The lamentable change is from the best;
The worst returns to laughter.
plain: Rock bottom is safer than the top. The one at the very bottom has nowhere to fall and only goes up.

text:
I have no way, and therefore want no eyes;
I stumbled when I saw. Full oft ’tis seen
Our means secure us, and our mere defects
Prove our commodities.
plain: What you have can make you careless, and what you lack can end up being your strength.

text:
And worse I may be yet. The worst is not
So long as we can say ‘This is the worst.’
plain: You are not at the worst as long as you can still say it is the worst. It can always go lower, so keep your head up.

text:
As flies to wanton boys are we to the gods,
They kill us for their sport.
plain: On the worst days it feels like the gods swat us for sport. Say it out loud, then get up anyway.

text:
Let the superfluous and lust-dieted man,
That slaves your ordinance, that will not see
Because he does not feel, feel your power quickly;
So distribution should undo excess,
And each man have enough.
plain: If the people with too much shared a little, everyone would have enough.

text:
It is the stars,
The stars above us govern our conditions;
Else one self mate and make could not beget
Such different issues.
plain: Two people from the same stock can turn out completely different. Fate shapes more than we admit.
Wealth hides sin and poverty exposes it. The system goes easy on those with gold.

text: Go to, they are not men o’ their words: they told me I was everything; ’tis a lie, I am not ague-proof.
plain: The people who told you that you were everything were lying. You get cold and sick like anyone else.

text:
When we are born, we cry that we are come
To this great stage of fools.
plain: We cry when we arrive on this stage of fools. Do not take any of it too seriously.
Hard blows teach you what pain feels like, and that makes you kind to others who are hurting.

text:
I am a very foolish fond old man,
Fourscore and upward, not an hour more nor less;
And to deal plainly,
I fear I am not in my perfect mind.
plain: He drops the act and admits he is old, foolish, and not sure of his own mind. Honesty like that is strength.

text:
My point and period will be throughly wrought,
Or well or ill, as this day’s battle’s fought.
plain: It will end well or badly, but it is going to be finished today either way.
